head: 63edc36e303fabbecb755a4adef5dc55d41c47da
summary: InitiatePaymentIT and IdempotentInitiationIT no longer depend on saga progress: POST status asserted INITIATED, DB/GET status asserted within INITIATED plus its allowed next states, bodies compared without status/reason. Test-only change, no sleeps. PR body must still record B2/B3 evidence.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: InitiatePaymentIT.java:63-87: INITIATED asserted only on the synchronous POST body; stored and GET status asserted with isIn(INITIATED + PaymentStatus.INITIATED.next()); id, parties, amount, initiatedAt compared via PaymentJson.withoutProgress.

IdempotentInitiationIT compared full bodies of replays (lines 53,74,143-147), same race; fixed with PaymentJson.withoutProgress. PaymentSagaIT/DeadLetterIT use await or follow nextCommandFor, PaymentOutboxIT and PaymentServiceApplicationIT read no status: safe. These reasons must be listed in the PR body.
Not verifiable in the repo: the 20-run result belongs in the PR body (not created yet); reported by the implementer as 20/20 passes, not committed. Local test-summary pass 446/446 on head, clean.

findings.description: statusesFromInitiated allows only INITIATED and its direct successors, not every reachable state. It holds here because no ledger answers, but it is a one-step bound, not the full closure the saga could reach.
findings.suggestion: Optional: allow all non-INITIATED states reachable transitively, or comment why one step suffices.

findings.description: DisplayName still prefixed B3 while this test proves B1-style behaviour of the brief; pre-existing from the UC3 numbering.
